# Mountain Race Shop

> Motorcycle handling diagnosis and suspension engineering workshop serving Canberra, ACT, Snowy Monaro, Bombala, Delegate, Bega Valley and surrounding NSW regions.

Mountain Race Shop diagnoses motorcycle handling problems before recommending suspension work. Services include fork servicing, shock servicing, spring-rate and sag setup, suspension revalving, race support and engineering analysis. The workshop is at 2572 Shannons Flat Rd, Shannons Flat NSW 2620, Australia. Phone: +61 420 947 505. Email: craig@mountainraceshop.com.au.

## Positioning
Mountain Race Shop uses an engineering-backed diagnostic approach: rider complaint, bike, rider weight, terrain and use are considered before recommending springs, servicing, revalving or setup changes. The business is positioned around diagnosis and technical understanding rather than generic motorcycle repair or price competition.

## Geographic service areas
Canberra and ACT; Shannons Flat; Cooma and Snowy Monaro; Bombala and Delegate; Bega Valley and the NSW South Coast.
